title: Coherent wiki writes and page identity
codebase_type: Python local-first memory service with a file-backed wiki and an in-process client
change_scope: Four production modules coordinate page-list freshness, markdown-path ownership, memory links and batch-learning updates.
testing_approach: The regression suite uses temporary wiki directories and the public in-process client. It checks immediate visibility after writes, colliding normalized filenames, preservation of existing markdown, links and backlinks, grouped learning, and nearby read and duplicate-page behavior.
